additional_info.subject: RE: ID0374843-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000697] Charger offline on SCB & OCPP CRM:00642001414
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I went today on site and the charger was in failsafemode so I did a reboot after removing the cables of the 2 routers and the charger went back online. However, I had to connect my computer to the charger and to do a “register” on both routeurs to get the SCB and OCPP communication back.
The charger is now online on SCB and OCPP but I’m going to keep and eye on it to see if the problem comes back.
Thank you,
Best Regards,
